Welcome — this is the blog section of my academic website.

I plan to use this space for occasional posts on three themes:

1. **Research notes** — short write-ups of methods problems I run into (spatial interpolation quirks, DiD diagnostics, survey experiment design) and how I solved them.
2. **Energy and climate politics** — commentary on the political economy of electricity, from blackouts in Brazil to data centers in Georgia.
3. **R and data science** — reproducible workflows, visualization, and tooling for political science research.
